name: ecomargin
description: EcoMargin — Enterprise EV Charging Management Platform
author: EcoMargin Team

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=admin-panel"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=admin-panel
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=admin-panel
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=admin-panel
scripts.clean: rimraf frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules admin-panel/node_modules frontend/dist admin-panel/dist
